verdict.rationale: The service states up front that the founder route is online-only, with separate in-country and out-of-country flows. It also says applicants may verify identity and submit documents through the UK Immigration: ID Check app. That is a single, thin pre-disclosure of one identity-proofing step, not a complete published list of everything required before filing. missing for 10: an explicit up-front list of account-creation and sign-in or credential requirements, a full sequence of identity-proofing options (app vs. in-person biometrics), confirmation that these appear on the founder-visa page before starting, and independent or hands-on corroboration that nothing is discovered mid-flow.
